Section 1.  Initial Build-Out.  Tenant shall have the right to design and construct its initial clinical build-out of the Leased Premises, including specialized plumbing, medical gas lines, dedicated electrical circuits and panels, privacy partitions, examination and treatment rooms, and related clinical infrastructure (the “Initial Build-Out”),

in accordance with plans and specifications to be provided to Landlord for informational purposes. Landlord’s approval of the Initial Build-Out shall not be required except with respect to work affecting the structural components of the building or the base building electrical, mechanical, or life-safety systems outside the Leased Premises, in which case Landlord’s consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed, and shall be deemed granted if Landlord fails to respond within ten (10) business days after receipt of Tenant’s plans.

in accordance with sealed plans and specifications, including all shielding, floor loads, roof or slab penetrations, and effects on building systems and capacity, to be provided to Landlord for Landlord’s prior written approval, together with contractor identities, insurance certificates, and applicable permits. Tenant’s general contractor and major subcontractors shall be subject to Landlord’s prior written approval, particularly for medical-gas, life-safety, plumbing, and electrical work. Before work begins, Tenant shall provide builder’s-risk coverage, commercial general liability coverage naming Landlord and its lender as additional insureds, workers’ compensation coverage, and conditional and unconditional lien waivers with each draw. Landlord’s approval of the Initial Build-Out shall be required for work affecting the structural components of the building or the base building electrical, mechanical, or life-safety systems, in which case Landlord’s consent may be withheld in Landlord’s sole discretion. Tenant shall reimburse Landlord’s reasonable third-party review costs and shall deliver as-built drawings to Landlord within thirty (30) days after completion.

Section 1.  Abatement of Rent.

If the Leased Premises are damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, or if patient access to the Leased Premises is materially impaired by damage to common areas, Base Rent and Additional Rent shall fully abate from the date of such damage or destruction until the Leased Premises are restored and Tenant is able to resume normal clinical operations, without any requirement that the damage be proportionate to the abatement.

If the Leased Premises are damaged by fire or other casualty, Base Rent and Additional Rent shall abate only in proportion to the portion of the Leased Premises rendered untenantable and actually not used by Tenant, from the date of the casualty until that portion is restored. Full abatement shall apply only if the Leased Premises as a whole cannot reasonably be used for the Permitted Use.

Permitted Transfers.  Tenant may, without Landlord’s consent, assign this Lease or sublet all or any portion of the Leased Premises to: (a) an Affiliate of Tenant; (b) a successor entity resulting from a merger, reorganization, consolidation, or change of control of Tenant, or a purchaser of all or substantially all of Tenant’s assets or equity interests; or (c) any other entity licensed to provide outpatient medical services, provided that, in each case, (i) the assignee or subtenant assumes in writing all of Tenant’s obligations under this Lease, and (ii) Tenant provides Landlord with written notice within thirty (30) days thereafter. As used herein, “Affiliate” means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Tenant.

Consent-Required Transfers.  Tenant shall not, without Landlord’s prior written consent, which may be withheld in Landlord’s sole discretion, effect any Transfer. For purposes of this Article, “Transfer” includes any assignment, sublease, license, concession, management agreement affecting the Leased Premises, merger, reorganization, consolidation, direct or indirect change of control, sale of equity interests, or sale of all or substantially all of Tenant’s assets.
